### The Savior of the World
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/savior-of-the-world
Passage: John 4:39-42
Points:
- A personal testimony is a helpful pointer, but genuine saving faith comes through hearing the Word of Christ directly.
- The Samaritans progressed from relying on the woman's report to encountering and believing Jesus for themselves.
- Proclaiming Jesus as Savior of the world challenged Roman and Greek claims regarding imperial rulers and pagan deities.
- The title reveals that salvation is extended to all nations—both Jews and Gentiles—rather than a single ethnic group.
- Affirming Christ as the world's Savior highlights Him as the exclusive path to eternal life, rather than promising universal salvation.
